Job description

Fullstack Senior PHP Developer

Salary: €3200 gross

Remote position

Company: SAGA-ALLIANCE (Germany)

Employment type: Full-time

Work format: Remote

Job Description:

SAGA-ALLIANCE is a German IT company looking for a Fullstack Senior PHP Developer to work on a B2B-oriented web application.

The project is long-term and focuses on clean architecture, code quality, and system stability.

Responsibilities:

  • Development and maintenance of a B2B web application
  • Backend development using PHP and Laravel
  • Implementation of business logic and domain models
  • Development and maintenance of REST APIs
  • Working with PostgreSQL databases
  • Participation in architectural decisions and code reviews
  • Collaboration with the frontend part of the application

Requirements

  • Commercial experience with PHP 8.x
  • Strong Laravel knowledge
  • Experience with PostgreSQL
  • Design Patterns
  • Understanding of event-driven architecture
  • Practical experience with Domain-Driven Design
  • Experience with CQRS
  • Experience developing B2B systems
  • Understanding of fullstack web development
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and testable code
  • High level of autonomy and responsibility
  • English level: B1-B2
  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Minimum 10 years of commercial software development experience

Nice to have:

  • Experience with frontend technologies:
  • HTML5, CSS3
  • JavaScript (ES6+)
  • One of the frameworks: Vue.js / React / Angular
  • Experience with queues and asynchronous processing
  • Experience integrating third-party services and APIs
  • Understanding of UX principles for B2B products

We offer:

  • Fully remote work
  • Long-term project
  • 22 paid working days of annual leave
  • Paid sick leave
  • Stable workload and clear expectations
